PROTOCOL_COMMENT: KC Denmark DK8000 multicorer used for cores 1 and 2. Sediment cores obtained using multicorer in plastic liners. Gravity corer with 1.3 ton head weight used for core 3 for porosity determination and foraminiferal analysis. Box corer used for cores 4, 5, 6 and 7 when hard crust in tailings area hindered multicorer penetration. 50x50x50 cm steel sampling box with manual subsampling using plastic liners. Pore water samples collected with 0.15 μm Rhizon filters through predrilled holes in plastic liners at 1-2 cm depth intervals.
